questions.stem: All objects emit thermal radiation. The rate of emission depends on:

options.text: Only the colour of the object
The surface temperature, surface area, and nature of the surface (colour and texture)
Only the mass of the object
Only the shape of the object

questions.explanation: The rate of thermal radiation emission depends on: the surface temperature (hotter objects radiate more), the surface area (larger area radiates more), and the nature of the surface (dark, matt surfaces emit more than light, shiny surfaces).

questions.stem: A vacuum flask reduces heat transfer by radiation by using:

options.text: A silver (shiny) coating on the inner surfaces

questions.explanation: The silvered (shiny) surfaces of a vacuum flask reflect thermal radiation back, reducing both emission and absorption of infrared radiation. This, combined with the vacuum (which prevents conduction and convection), keeps drinks hot or cold.
